name: Strong
desc: Strong: Increases Attack, max HP, Defense, and final damage by 10%.

name: Shaken
desc: Shaken: Decreases Attack, max HP, Defense, and final damage by 20%.

name: Weak
desc: Weak: Decreases Attack, max HP, Defense, and final damage by 50%. Increases final damage taken by 50%.

name: Lost
desc: Lost: Decreases Attack, max HP, Defense, and final damage by 90%. Increases final damage taken by 90%.
